state_switch_claim: The draft has a closed state and a vector-open state. Opening the apparatus appends selector-vector shadow triplets to the selected surface; this remains a bookkeeping transform, while the traversal state uses selected line endings to choose omitted lines.

closed_state.description: Selected path without appended shadow slices.
lines: T4 Torn glass learns to sleep as ash.
R4a Rungs carry a staircase inside the hinge.
A4 After the cursor leaves, the room becomes screen.
V4 Vanished keys keep warming a field.
E4a Every answer sleeps beside a gate.
R4b Readers build the page by choosing motion.
S4 Static nests under the broken signal.
E4b Elsewhere the waiting room becomes engine.

open_state.description: Selected path after disclosure opens the apparatus; each selected line receives its selector-vector shadow slice.
